chunking: one translation unit per original declaring type; forward declarations, complete layout dependencies and template definitions separated; unchanged bytes preserve timestamps
limitations: Generic source classes have concrete compile/execution instances recorded per method; unexercised type arguments have no behavior receipt. Custom inheritance, source/interface slots, properties, per-type lazy initialization, method groups and closures use typed generated classes. Missing virtual bodies remain link errors rather than stubs.

Anonymous functions capture shared cells with GC tracing; captured foreach variables use C#6 fresh-per-iteration semantics. Game foreach-capture sites are inventoried separately because historical smcs C#3 differs. Goto with captured locals and unsupported protected-branch propagation remain rejected. Reflection is closed-world only; native compile and source differential receipts are separate evidence.
